name: CFCQ supernova field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Type Ia supernova CFCQ, seen by Hubble.
label: cfcq-hubble
story: A Subaru telescope survey caught a Type Ia supernova in this patch of sky, and Hubble followed up as part of a program pairing the two telescopes. Combining their views of many such supernovae helps sharpen measurements of dark energy.

claims.text: CFCQ is a Type Ia supernova targeted by Hubble program 15363, SUbaru Supernovae with Hubble Infrared (SUSHI)
The supernovae were found by the Subaru Strategic Program's rolling search with Hyper Suprime-Cam
Combining Subaru light curves with Hubble observations improves the dark energy Figure of Merit
